opportunities.point: Management expects margins to fluctuate within a range and could be around 10% to 25%, without falling back to earlier levels of 10% to 12%.
opportunities.evidence: Management guidance: "Going forward, margins may fluctuate within a range and could be around 10%–25%. However, we do not expect the margins to fall back to the earlier levels of around 10%–12%." (concall transcript - 2026-08-01)

opportunities.point: Frank Metals plans further capacity expansion in the aluminium extrusion business over the medium term.
opportunities.evidence: Capex / expansion plan: "Frank Metals plans further capacity expansion here, with the objective of building a scalable aluminium extrusion business over the medium term." (concall transcript - 2026-08-01)

opportunities.point: A new facility in Sampla, Haryana is under construction to produce 200 metric tons per month of zinc and aluminium ingots.
opportunities.evidence: Capex / expansion plan: "Our new facility in Sampla, it's coming and it's under construction phase. We will produce zinc ingot, aluminum ingots in it with 200 metric ton per month under construction." (concall transcript - 2026-08-01)

opportunities.point: Sales are outgrowing costs - operating leverage should widen margins.
Rising institutional interest can keep supporting the price.
opportunities.evidence: POSITIVE MONEY FLOW - institutional holding change 0.94 pp

opportunities.point: Nupur Extrusion operates its Haryana facility catering to solar plant manufacturing and OEM customers, which are seeing strong, secular demand.
opportunities.evidence: Demand outlook: "Nupur Extrusion Private Limited operates our Haryana facility and is currently running at 1800 MT per annum capacity against total production capacity of 2400 MT per annum, catering to solar plant manufacturing and OEM (original equipment manufacturer)..." (concall transcript - 2026-08-01)

opportunities.point: Management noted that India's lithium-ion battery recycling industry is expected to grow rapidly as electric vehicle adoption scales up.
opportunities.evidence: Demand outlook: "India's lithium-ion battery recycling industry is still at an early stage, but expected to grow rapidly as electric vehicle adoption scale up." (concall transcript - 2026-08-01)

opportunities.point: Nupur Recyclers imports approximately 8,000 to 10,000 tonnes of scrap metal annually across stainless steel, zinc, and aluminium.
opportunities.evidence: Orders / capacity: "Every year, we import approximately 8,000 to 10,000 tonnes of scrap metal, spread across three metals: around 4,000 tonnes of stainless steel, 3,000 tonnes of zinc, and 2,000 tonnes of aluminium." (concall transcript - 2026-08-01)

opportunities.point: Nupur Extrusion in Sampla has an installed capacity of 2,400 tons per annum and uses 1,800 tons per annum.
opportunities.evidence: Orders / capacity: "So, we have another facility Nupur Extrusion in Sampla, Haryana. This aluminum extrusion we are producing here. 2,400 tons per annum is its installed capacity and still we are using 1,800 tons per annum. It's running at 75% right now." (concall transcript - 2026-08-01)

opportunities.point: Management stated that the Sampla LFP battery recycling facility is expected to become operational over the next 2 to 3 months.
opportunities.evidence: Management commitment: "It is against this backdrop that we are setting up a new facility in Sampla, Haryana with 6,000 tons LFP battery recycling, lithium iron phosphate battery recycling plant. Spread across 5 acres, expected to become operational over next 2 to 3 months." (concall transcript - 2026-08-01) [next 2 to 3 months]

opportunities.point: Management expects the Nupur Extrusion plant capacity to increase to about 350 tons per month by the end of this financial year.
opportunities.evidence: Management commitment: "We already ordered one more Chinese automatic machine which is 4 inches machine. So, it should be in for the next two or three quarters or maybe this financial year end. We will go by about 350 tons per month." (concall transcript - 2026-08-01) [this financial year end]

opportunities.point: Management stated that the Sampla plant for zinc and aluminium ingots will be ready for manufacturing in the next two to three months.
opportunities.evidence: Management commitment: "So, sir, regarding Sampla plant, already the land is purchased in which construction is in progress. And in the next two to three months it will be ready for manufacturing." (concall transcript - 2026-08-01) [next two to three months]
